item.title: Josh Ross Earns First Country Airplay No. 1 With ‘Hate How You Look’
item.description:
[Upbeat music fades out]
Host: Welcome to this week's Billboard update. We've got some exciting news to share with you.
First up, a big congratulations to Josh Ross, who has just achieved his first-ever Billboard Country Airplay No. 1 with his song "Hate How You Look". This track has been climbing the charts for 40 weeks, and it's finally reached the top spot, drawing in 32.7 million audience impressions.
Ross isn't the only one making waves, though. Bailey Zimmerman's "Chevy Silverado" has just revved its way into the top 10, marking his seventh Country Airplay top 10. And we've also got some new entries to talk about, with Cole Swindell's "Girl Dad" opening at No. 26 and Jelly Roll's "Hands Up" entering at No. 28.
[Short music transition]
Host: It's worth noting that Josh Ross is the second artist this year to secure a first Country Airplay No. 1, following in the footsteps of Tucker Wetmore. And he's part of a larger trend - since 2016, 54 artists have achieved their first No. 1 on the Country Airplay chart.
[Closing music starts]
Host: That's all for this week's update. Thanks for tuning in. You can check out the full charts, including all the latest updates, on Billboard.com. We'll catch you next time.
[Music fades out]
